text.text_excerpt: Well hello sausage heaven. My name is Sara and I just wanted to say that you are very welcome to stay at Kajuns Pub for as long as you can. Please don't move too far away as I really do appreciate your love for all things cased meats. And I am so happy that even though you are in the Marigny you will deliver right to my door in the quarter:) Now, my husband did not really like the hot dog, but he is boring and just wanted ketchup. How silly, I know!! I however devoured my Southern Dog with fried green tomatoes with that yummy sauce on top. Oh and what on earth do you do to the pimento cheese that makes it so irresistible or those fabulous pickles that come with it? Our table mates were lo...

great diveish bar on st claude so not in the thick of things. food was really really good. i got a burger that was easily top 5 in the city. very juicy. very nice. my lady got a lamb dog with artichoke cream. it was very original and very very good. the fries were homemade and those were great too. i really liked it a lot. good place for sure.

Great Restaurant Adjunct to Kajuns Pub SITREP On the Saturday Night Pub Crawl I enjoyed before my last day in NOLA, I got to come to Kajun's Pub and enjoy the sausagey goodness of Borracho. THE SETUP Kajun's is a great pub on St. Claude Ave and it was here we stopped first to get some munchies. They have great home cut fries and a delicious fresh ketchup that they make themselves. Our meal also included a delicious fresh cut potato chip ensemble with a creamy sauce, and then deep-fried chicken livers. And then the sausage entree.
